scope: One S4 wordmark asset chain; Root owns native state, Figma, independent review and human acceptance.
output_discovery: Explicit --output-dir, or script directory. Create the output directory and restore FROZEN_SPEC.json first.
root_guard_prerequisite: Complete native validation must pass and Root must release the asset writer before any execution.
inputs: Original G/R and COPY_MANIFEST exact SHA identities in SOURCE_EXTRACTION.json
limitations: Grain counts describe the source mask. Spline fitting and mapping can omit subpixel holes; do not claim every source hole is visible in the final SVG. Fresh independent full-poster review remains required.
